balanceLow.subject: Low balance in "Acme"
balanceLow.text:
Low balance in "Acme"

The prepaid balance of the workspace "Acme" at code-review.com is low: $1.20 is left.
Reviews keep starting while there is credit. Add credit so they do not stop.

Open the billing page to add credit:
https://reviews.example.test/x?token=abc123

You get this message because you are an Owner or an Admin of the workspace. It is sent once when the balance drops into this state, and again only after the balance was topped up and has dropped again.

modelChoice.MODEL_CHOICE_HINT: How reviews of this kind are done. code-review.com takes care of the rest.
modelChoice.MODEL_CHOICE_NONE_CHOSEN: Nothing is chosen yet, so the code-review.com default applies.
modelChoice.MODEL_CHOICE_NONE_OFFERED: code-review.com offers no choice for this kind of review yet. Reviews use its default.
modelChoice.MODEL_CHOICE_CHOSEN_UNAVAILABLE: The chosen option is not available right now, so reviews do not start until another one is chosen.
